=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
[psyir] fparser2 frontend currently ignores implicit statements
To date we have always (implicitly) assumed that the Fortran we are dealing with is using `implicit none`. The fparser2 psyir frontend needs extending to check that this is the case and to abort if not.
